changes: Standard/extended use a new 15 g frozen-coriander dose instead of 5 g epazote, boiled into retained broth. Frozen jalapeno and garlic explicitly cook; extended carrot/celery/lime remain distinct.

Explicit shell-free version: new 200 g frozen mussel meat replaces 600 g live shell-on mussels, not a shell-yield conversion. Raw peeled Miramar shrimp use the unchanged 250 g declared product mass including its added water/salt, not 100 percent pure flesh. Thaw all seafood under refrigeration, boil all thaw liquid and retain all broth. Separate water addition/boiling from passive rice simmer.
recipes.content_review: Två ytterligare nivåer av den buljongrika fisk-/skaldjursrisgrytan, med vitlök/jalapeño och morot/selleri/lime. Uttrycklig korianderversion utan epazote stöds av receptförfattaren https://mysliceofmexico.ca/2025/02/06/arroz-a-la-tumbada-a-rice-and-seafood-mish-mash/ som använder koriander och gör epazote valfri. Ny dos och genomkokning av fryst ört, inte samma örtidentitet eller arom.
